description: A company's audited traction report, from a share link it gave you: the summary and auditor-style opinion, up to three key numbers, each claim tested (supported, not supported, not testable), then usage, retention, pilot to production, concentration and outcome rates per customer-month, every number with its sample size, period, evidence tier and provenance (connected, or witnessed data the customer reconciled; never uploads), and the signed attestation. Opening it is logged in the company's view log. Links limited to named people need a browser sign-in.

token.description: The token at the end of the share link.

name: get_traction_report
title: Read a shared traction report
